# neo4jaura_organization_invites (Data Source)

Lists pending and historical invites for an Aura organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization the invites belong to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the invites data source.
- `invites` (Attributes List) The list of invites for the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites))

<a id="nestedatt--invites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The email address of the invitee.
- `expires_at` (String) The timestamp after which the invite can no longer be accepted.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the invite.
- `invited_by` (String) The ID of the user who created the invite.
- `organization_roles` (List of String) The organization roles granted to the invitee. Possible values: `organization-owner`, `organization-admin`, `organization-member`.
- `project_invites` (Attributes List) Project roles granted to the invitee alongside the organization role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites--project_invites))
- `status` (String) The status of the invite. Possible values: `active`, `accepted`, `revoked`, `expired`, `declined`.

<a id="nestedatt--invites--project_invites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites.project_invites`

Read-Only:

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `project_roles` (List of String) The project roles granted. Possible values: `namespace-viewer`, `namespace-member`, `namespace-admin`, `namespace-metrics-integration-reader`.
